subject: Procurement: PO placement, consolidated invoice cadence & prompt-pay trade
messages:
From: Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@ascendanthealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ascendant AP <ap@ascendanthealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement: PO and invoicing requirements for Redwood contract

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the draft commercial terms. Before we sign, Procurement/Accounts Payable needs a few confirmations on how invoices and POs will be handled operationally so our ERP won’t auto-reject them. High level asks from our side:

- We require a PO number on every invoice as an invoice header field (our EDI/ERP rejects invoices without a PO header).
- We prefer a single consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity (one statement), but our AP team also needs to see the full list of PO numbers referenced on that single invoice so they can route line items to the right cost centers.
- Our standard payment term is Net60; we can discuss faster payment in exchange for a small prompt-pay discount but need clear settlement windows reflected in the invoice metadata.
- Remittance and vendor code: please confirm the billing entity name and the vendor code you want us to use in our system. We also need your standard remittance address/ACH details for EFT setup.

Can Redwood support a consolidated monthly statement that includes a header PO (required) plus a PO reference column per line item (optional), and can you expose PO metadata fields in the invoice file (CSV/EDIFACT/JSON)? If not, what alternatives do you recommend?

Appreciate a quick response — our procurement cutoff for Q1 onboarding is Jan 29.

Best,
Laura Martinez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Ascendant Health

Attachment: none

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@ascendanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO and invoicing requirements for Redwood contract

Hi Laura — thanks for laying this out, very helpful. We can support the consolidated monthly statement approach with some guardrails. Proposed options from our side:

Option A — Consolidated monthly statement (preferred):
- Single PDF/CSV statement sent once per month per billing entity.
- Invoice header must include one primary PO number for the statement (we can map this to your ERP header).
- We will include an explicit PO reference column on each line item (multiple PO values allowed) so AP can route to individual POs/cost centers.

Option B — One invoice per PO (strict PO policy):
- Redwood will emit separate invoice documents for each PO. Lower complexity for mapping but increases invoice volume.

About Net terms / prompt-pay:
- Standard hosted customers are billed Net45. We can offer a prompt-pay discount in exchange for earlier terms: 1.0% for Net30 or 0.5% for Net45. If Ascendant needs Net60, we would ask to keep list pricing (no prompt-pay discount).
- We can support ACH/EFT and provide remittance details for vendor setup.

Technical and next steps:
- I’m attaching our invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.xlsx) — it shows the header fields and the per-line PO reference column we can populate.
- Ben (Finance) can confirm the exact field names we’ll put in the machine-readable export (CSV/JSON) for ERP ingestion.

If you can confirm which option (A or B) you prefer and whether the organization can accept Net45 with a 0.5% prompt-pay credit, we’ll draft a quick amendment and send for signature.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, invoice header + line-item PO reference column)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO and invoicing requirements for Redwood contract

Mina / Vanessa — quick technical note from Finance on what we can reliably support from an ERP/export perspective.

1) Invoice payload and PO mapping (recommended):
- Invoice header fields: invoice_id, invoice_date, billing_entity, primary_po (string), total_amount, remittance_instructions
- Line items: line_id, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, po_reference (string, can be CSV of multiple PO ids), cost_center
- We will provide the CSV and JSON exports and the PDF statement. Our billing pipeline can populate a "po_reference" on each line and set a single "primary_po" in the header to satisfy header-validation rules.

2) Consolidation rules:
- If you require a single header PO but multiple PO references in lines, we will accept a header primary_po and allow line-level po_reference values. NOTE: some ERPs still require one PO per invoice; if Ascendant’s system is strictly enforced, choose Option B (one invoice per PO).

3) Discount handling for prompt-pay:
- We can implement a 1.5% prompt-pay discount for Net30 (one-time contractual amendment) OR 1.0% for Net35, OR 0.5% for Net45. Our preference is Net30/1.5% to minimize receivables days. Discount will appear as a separate line on the consolidated statement with a discount reference code.

4) Remittance setup and vendor code:
- Please provide your ERP vendor code and remittance contact. We will return our vendor banking details (ACH instructions) for EFT onboarding.

I’ll attach a sample JSON mapping of the invoice payload for your ERP team to validate. If Ascendant can accept Net45 / 0.5% that’s the quickest path, otherwise we can draft the amendment for Net30/1.5%.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_mapping_sample.json (sample payload showing header + line-item PO references)

From: Laura Martinez <laura.martinez@ascendanthealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ascendant AP <ap@ascendanthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO and invoicing requirements for Redwood contract

Mina / Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround and the options. We reviewed with AP + ERP team and can confirm the following: 

- We will accept Option A (consolidated monthly statement) provided the invoice header contains at least one primary_po and the exported line items include a po_reference column that can hold multiple PO ids (CSV within the field). That will allow our invoice-matching rules to route charges correctly.
- Ascendant can move to Net45, and we can agree to the 0.5% prompt-pay credit.
- We will add the amendment that spells out the discount schedule (Net45 = 0.5% credit applied to monthly statement). Please send the DocuSign when you have the amendment.
- Vendor code: use vendor code AHC-REDW-77. Remittance: ACH details accepted; please send bank account + ACH routing for EFT onboarding (secure link preferred).

Quoting Ben for clarity:
On Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 9:22 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I can implement a 1.5% prompt-pay discount for Net30 (one-time amendment) OR 1.0% for Net35, OR 0.5% for Net45. Our preference is Net30/1.5% to minimize receivables days. Discount will appear as a separate line on the consolidated statement with a discount reference code.

We’ll take Net45/0.5% per your template. Once we have the amendment in DocuSign and a secure link for ACH details we will initiate vendor setup (goal: have vendor active by Feb 10 so Q1 billing flows correctly).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Martinez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Ascendant Health

Attachment: proposed_amendment_ascendant_redwood.pdf (draft amendment for prompt-pay credit)
